title: Run a subscription CLI as a hub worker
goal: Your logged-in official CLI claims tasks for its role binding

steps.title: Your login stays on your device
steps.text: Subscriptions such as Claude Pro/Max or ChatGPT Plus/Pro work only inside the vendor's own CLI on your machine. The hub never stores, copies or proxies that login. Whether a non-interactive worker counts as ordinary use is unverified for each vendor.

steps.title: Add the subscription
steps.text: Open Subscriptions → Add, choose the provider, kind CLI login, and the machine where the CLI is logged in. No secret is entered for CLI logins.

steps.title: Create a worker token
steps.text: In Agents, create a token for the worker principal and save it to a 0600 file on that machine; it is shown once.

steps.title: Connect the CLI to the hub
steps.text: Open Connect and copy the 'Run as a subscription worker' command for your chat app, then run it on that machine.

steps.title: Bind a role to it
steps.text: In Role bindings choose the role and chat app, pick this subscription and an optional fallback.

steps.title: Done
steps.text: Tasks labelled with that role now route to your CLI worker while its machine is online.
